Definition: Count distinct incident_id in reporting period.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Count distinct incident IDs; validate duplicates and severity.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: any Critical incident or upward trend
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Review severity mix, drivers and action owners.

Definition:
Open findings with Unpatched or Partially patched status; 
show Critical/High and overdue subset.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Distinct finding_id; exclude closed; report risk-accepted separately.
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Prioritise critical assets; agree remediation or formal exception.

Definition: Delivered campaign-recipient rows with click / all delivered campaign-recipient rows × 100.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Use delivered recipients as denominator; show campaign and sample size.
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Review repeat clickers and target awareness.

Definition: Count events with agreed suspicious/unauthorized classifications.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Failed login alone is not proof of attack; document in-scope classifications.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: material increase vs baseline or privileged-account event
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Triage context, investigate and document false positives.

Definition: Completed required assignments / eligible required assignments × 100.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Define active employee population and whether only assignments due by snapshot count.
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Notify managers and target overdue groups.

Definition: Count distinct breach_id with confirmation_status = Confirmed.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Use breach register; not all incidents are breaches.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: any confirmed breach triggers review
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Escalate via breach process; legal/privacy team assesses notifications.

Definition: Eligible entities with MFA enabled / all eligible entities × 100.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Segment human vs system accounts and criticality; exclude ineligible entities.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: below 98% or critical eligible system without MFA
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Prioritise privileged and critical production identities.

Definition: Average detected_at minus occurred_at for incidents with valid timestamps.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Use consistent time unit; show median, sample size and coverage; exclude invalid pairs.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: rising trend or internal objective missed
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Review telemetry gaps, alert tuning and reporting delays.

Definition: For this exercise: average response_started_at minus detected_at.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: This is response-start latency, not time-to-resolution; report valid sample count.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: rising trend or severe-incident target missed
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Review triage and on-call handoffs; agree the organisation's MTTR meaning.

Definition: Show backup job failure rate and recovery-test failure rate as separate percentages.
Calculation_and_Data_Rules: Never combine their denominators; segment critical systems and RTO failures.
Illustrative_Threshold_or_Trigger: Illustrative: any failed critical recovery test or repeated backup failures
Suggested_Escalation_Action: Investigate failures and verify restore capability.
